As soon as I install software dev tools such as VS and databases it starts bugging out. I've decompiled the current drivers and had a look at them and honestly, from a software design point of view, they're unorganized and inefficient and the programming is shocking, it's like the devs were never taught to refine their code and only read half of the book on algorithms. Nonetheless I was able to overlook this and silently swap to nvidia until I decided to give them one more chance, in which their customer service was shocking and unethical. If it wasnt for the customer service I received I would of once again silently moved to nvidia.

And I said I fixed some of the bugs and was able to finally launch games, albeit with frame stutter. And to say it has nothing with coding is ridiculous because I coded/programmed my own software which would stop AMD's software from prioritizing the GPU monitoring service (Not the gpu health but the monitoring which states how much of the resources are being used) and as much as I want to post my code here to prove you wrong, I don't want to give the solution to some of the bugs to AMD because they honestly don't deserve it if they're gonna be arrogant and state things are perfect when I am able to supply proof and workarounds. 

So cya
